findings.finding: Old PalwCertificationOutcomeV1::certifies accepts Certified OR PublicCheckCertified. Its Reproduced row/verdict is not the new PositiveCourtVerdictV2 and cannot supply P credit.

The current exact table136 scanner accepts S/V claim rows, C/N bookkeeping and F frontier forms, then rejects other table136 namespaces. P has no value codec here. K/H handling also appears absent and needs a separate executable legacy-compatibility check; this observation does not authorize a new P codec.
New PositiveCourtAttestationV2 is decoded as operation7 but handled as External. The mandatory native external validator does not yet have an actual P accepted writer.
Attestation identity/signature shape is assigned; native P row/getter/draw-record ID derivation/scanner/fold remain unassigned, explicitly so in the contract.

Independent native TIR Assignment authority is an unadopted RFC/ADR pair. Existing freeze requires explicit adoption of both. No peer Result-derived job, old S/K/V approval, saved pass or new optimistic default is an acceptable implementation shortcut.

next_native_action_requires: adopt the concrete native RFC/ADR and complete the explicit P row/draw/one-writer contract; actual P must count only selected-verifier Certified under the stated honest-fraction premise
